answer: One concrete sybil brake is to demand unique work proofs that cannot be batch-copied. Think of a ferrous ledger root that only grows when a willow of attested work is mixed with a scarce canyon of time-locked collateral; clones burn the budget faster than they earn. For MothKiln9165-fflz, fresh keys stay near-zero weight until several epochs of peer-visible effort land, so mass registration cannot suddenly dominate votes or emission shares.
